name: Clear Print Queue
description: Removes stuck print jobs from the Windows Print Spooler to fix unresponsive printers. This clears queued files but keeps your installed printer drivers and settings intact.

description_i18n.en: Removes stuck print jobs from the Windows Print Spooler to fix unresponsive printers. This clears queued files but keeps your installed printer drivers and settings intact.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt hängende Druckaufträge aus dem Windows-Druckspooler, um nicht reagierende Drucker zu beheben. Dies löscht Warteschlangenfiles behält aber Ihre installierten Treiber und Einstellungen bei.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les travaux d'impression bloqués du spouleur Windows pour corriger des imprimantes non réactives. Cela efface les fichiers en file mais conserve vos pilotes et paramètres.

warnings.title: Print Jobs Removed
warnings.message: All pending print jobs in memory are deleted immediately. You will need to resend any documents that were queued for printing after this action runs

warnings.title: Printer Connectivity Impact
warnings.message: The Print Spooler service restarts briefly during execution. Your printer may temporarily appear offline or stop printing until the service is fully restarted

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Stops the Print Spooler service, deletes files from C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, and restarts the service
